title: Be careful with the annual subscription!
text:
Be very careful before starting the free trial! The app only offers an annual subscription, with no monthly option. I forgot to cancel my trial, but canceled immediately on the same day I was charged and requested a refund through Apple. Apple denied my request, and even after contacting support, they refused to offer any solution, not even a partial refund for the unused months.

Now I’m stuck paying for an entire year of an app I don’t want to use. I’m sharing my experience so other people don’t end up in the same situation. Very frustrating and disappointing!

title: Pls Daylio Read this
text:
I’ve been using Daylio for over 2 years and it contains some of the most important memories of my life. I trusted this app with very personal moments, including audio recordings, photos, and journal entries.

Unfortunately, there are serious issues on iPhone that need improvement. When I receive a phone call while recording an audio entry, the recording gets interrupted or cut off. On top of that, the iCloud backup/sync system does not feel safe or reliable enough.

When my iCloud storage became full, I didn’t lose just 1 or 2 entries — I lost around 200 entries containing audio recordings, pictures, texts, and memories collected over years. After upgrading my iCloud storage and syncing again, most of those older entries disappeared permanently. My text entries partially remained, but many audios and attached memories were gone.

For an app based on preserving personal memories, there should be much stronger protection against data loss, especially with iCloud syncing on iPhone. Users should have:

* safer backup systems,
* recovery options,
* better warnings before syncing overwrites data,
* and protection for audio recordings.

This app means a lot to me, which is why losing years of memories has been heartbreaking. I really hope the developers improve backup security and data recovery for long-term users.

text: It’s a great app for tracking and customizable on multiple levels, which is fun! You can choose categories, colors, emojis, etc. but lately it’s been really buggy- it keeps crashing, especially when you start a new entry and go to select categories and moods. I like the idea of being able to track patterns (especially around my menstrual cycle or activities tied to certain moods and activities) but the % breakdown and pattern analysis/related activities just seems off- I wish there was a way to customize this more. So this app is helpful for daily tracking, but for overall pattern identifying, it needs some work (and crashes more frequently). I have premium.
